description: This file defines the BlockViewBuilder class in Drupal, responsible for building and rendering block entities with caching, lazy loading, and pre-rendering support.

classes.name: BlockViewBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds and renders block entities with caching and lazy loading support.

methods.name: buildComponents
methods.description: Builds components for rendering a block, implementation not provided.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Returns a render array for a single block entity in a specified view mode.

methods.name: viewMultiple
methods.description: Builds render arrays for multiple block entities, handling cache and placeholder logic.

methods.name: buildPreRenderableBlock
methods.description: Creates a pre-renderable render array for a block entity, including context injection and plugin info.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags for the block view, which are empty as blocks do not use view cache tags.

methods.name: trustedCallbacks
methods.description: Returns list of trusted callback method names for security.

methods.name: lazyBuilder
methods.description: Builds a block render array lazily, used as a #lazy_builder callback.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Pre-render callback that renders block content and manages cacheability and placeholder logic.
